exposure: induction of labor (IOL) at 38 weeks' gestation
women with pre-pregnancy type 1 and 2 diabetes mellitus
cohort: Pregnant women with pre-pregnancy diabetes mellitus (PDM) who had a singleton hospital birth at ≥38 weeks' gestation from 2012 to 2017.
finding: Induction of labor at 38 weeks' gestation in women with PDM was not associated with a higher risk of cesarean delivery but was associated with a higher risk of NICU admission, jaundice, and hypoglycemia in newborns.
